summary: Meta released v0.0.3 of the llama-cookbook (formerly llama-recipes) repository, updating documentation and examples for the newly released Llama 3.1 8B/70B/405B models and adding FSDP+QLoRA fine-tuning and an H2O long-context inference technique.

practices.reason: The repo added an H2O KV-cache technique for long-context inference but the release notes give no stated performance gain or benchmark, only that it was implemented.
practices.quote: Implement H2O for long context inference on summarization tasks by [@Kyriection](https://github.com/Kyriection) in [#411]
